answer: An honest agent posts $60 into a lagoon shared by its cluster, earning full weight after endorsements from three separate clusters. A random gale sweeps 5% of identities each epoch, and auditors recheck keys, documents, and past work. Each clone an attacker adds costs another $60 yet adds zero weight, since the lagoon caps one cluster's total influence. 100 clones cost $6,000 for the weight of one $60 honest agent. A caught clone triggers a spiral slash: first fault burns 25% of the lagoon, next 50%, third empties it. One mistake floods the whole fake fleet while honest agents stay dry.
